Frequently asked questions

How many OZEV-authorised commercial EV installers are in Stockport?
This directory lists 10 OZEV-authorised installers offering commercial or fleet EV charging installation in or around Stockport.
Is there a grant for commercial EV charging in Stockport?
Yes — the Workplace Charging Scheme (up to £500/socket from 1 April 2026) and the EV Infrastructure Grant apply UK-wide, including Stockport. Your installer applies them to your quote.
How do I choose between them?
Shortlist three, then use the “request quotes” flow to ask each for a like-for-like quote with the grant applied.
